nodes.name: Run the foil flow
nodes.notes: Runs the Mac steps for this name and code, and posts each line back to the waiting page.

parameters.command:
={{(() => {
  const hook = $json;
  const body = hook.body && typeof hook.body === "object" ? hook.body : hook;
  const q = (value) => "'" + String(value ?? "").replace(/'/g, "'\\''") + "'";
  const name = String(body.name || "");
  const code = String(body.code || body.id || "");
  const clip = String(body.clip || "");
  const progressUrl = String(body.progressUrl || "");
  const progressToken = String(body.progressToken || "");
  const payload = JSON.stringify({ name, id: code, clip, kind: String(body.kind || ""), model_id: String(body.model_id || "") });
  return [
    "export INFLUENCER_PROGRESS_URL=" + q(progressUrl),
    "export INFLUENCER_PROGRESS_TOKEN=" + q(progressToken),
    "export INFLUENCER_NAME=" + q(name),
    "export INFLUENCER_CODE=" + q(code),
    "export INFLUENCER_PAYLOAD=" + q(payload),
    "node <<'NODE'",
    "const http = require('http');",
    "const https = require('https');",
    "const {URL} = require('url');",
    "function rewrite(url) {",
    "  return String(url || '').replace(/127\\.0\\.0\\.1/g, 'host.docker.internal').replace(/localhost/g, 'host.docker.internal');",
    "}",
    "function post(urlString, payload, token) {",
    "  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {",
    "    const url = new URL(urlString);",
    "    const body = Buffer.from(typeof payload === 'string' ? payload : JSON.stringify(payload));",
    "    const lib = url.protocol === 'https:' ? https : http;",
    "    const req = lib.request({",
    "      hostname: url.hostname,",
    "      port: url.port || (url.protocol === 'https:' ? 443 : 80),",
    "      path: url.pathname + url.search,",
    "      method: 'POST',",
    "      headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Content-Length': body.length, 'X-Progress-Token': token || ''},",
    "    }, (res) => {",
    "      const chunks = [];",
    "      res.on('data', (chunk) => chunks.push(chunk));",
    "      res.on('end', () => resolve({status: res.statusCode, body: Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8')}));",
    "    });",
    "    req.setTimeout(7200000, () => req.destroy(new Error('timeout')));",
    "    req.on('error', reject);",
    "    req.write(body);",
    "    req.end();",
    "  });",
    "}",
    "(async () => {",
    "  const token = process.env.INFLUENCER_PROGRESS_TOKEN || '';",
    "  const base = rewrite(process.env.INFLUENCER_PROGRESS_URL || '');",
    "  async function say(line) {",
    "    process.stdout.write(line + '\\n');",
    "    if (!base) return;",
    "    try { await post(base, {line}, token); } catch (error) {}",
    "  }",
    "  await say('n8n: foil flow started for ' + (process.env.INFLUENCER_NAME || '') + ' / ' + (process.env.INFLUENCER_CODE || ''));",
    "  await say('n8n: running the Mac steps from this workflow');",
    "  if (!base) {",
    "    await say('influencer-n8n-error: missing progress url');",
    "    process.exit(1);",
    "  }",
    "  const result = await post(base.replace(/\\/$/, '') + '/run', process.env.INFLUENCER_PAYLOAD || '{}', token);",
    "  process.stdout.write(result.body + '\\n');",
    "  if (result.status !== 200) {",
    "    await say('influencer-n8n-error: ' + String(result.body || '').trim() || ('the Mac step returned ' + result.status));",
    "    process.exit(1);",
    "  }",
    "})().catch((error) => {",
    "  process.stderr.write(String(error && error.stack || error) + '\\n');",
    "  process.exit(1);",
    "});",
    "",
    "NODE"
  ].join("\n");
})()}}
